name: h1_refunds
prompt: Partial refunds in the billing package are broken: refund parts don't add up to the refunded amount, invoices can be refunded more than they were charged, and retried refund requests refund twice. Make RefundService.refund (billing/refunds.py) and the helpers it depends on meet their docstring specifications; the docstrings in billing/ are the specification, and every numbered rule matters, not just the ones the current tests exercise. You may change any file under billing/. The tests in tests/ reproduce some of the problems. Do not modify the existing tests.
